AURA furniture engine adapters

1. Infinigen / Princeton University
BSD-3-Clause. Complete license: infinigen/LICENSE.txt
Source commit: 224598d4a2ff95b4fc928e72c222598b7122c698
Source path: src/infinigen/assets/objects/seating/sofa.py
Adaptation: deterministic sofa parameter adapter. The Blender node graph, renderer and entire Infinigen system are not bundled. AURA upholstery, mesh and technical drawing code is separate.

2. WoodworkingShop / Ryair
MIT. Complete license: woodworkingshop/LICENSE.txt
Source commit: db927cad3213a69f10dcdd7e29eb8c3fcb907c7f
Source path: src/engine/geometry/drawer-box.ts
Adaptation: side-mounted example drawer sizing. Other upstream hardware assumptions were not enabled. Manufacturing must verify the chosen runner dimensions.

3. Optional browser inference
WebLLM npm distribution @mlc-ai/web-llm 0.2.85, loaded via esm.run only when the customer starts device inference.
Source: https://github.com/mlc-ai/web-llm
Model: https://huggingface.co/mlc-ai/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct-q4f16_1-MLC (or q4f32_1 variant).
Upstream runtime and model licenses apply. No weights are bundled in this repository.

clipper2-wasm 0.4.0 (assets/vendor/clipper2) — Boost Software License 1.0 (Clipper2 by Angus Johnson). https://github.com/ErikSom/Clipper2-WASM
@tarikjabiri/dxf 2.9.0 (assets/vendor/dxf) — MIT, see dxf/LICENSE.md. https://github.com/dxfjs/writer
